hook_text: The power is off, but the torch still shines. Where is its energy coming from?
clip_script: Power cut in Soshanguve. Homework by torchlight. Open the torch: two cells joined together, a battery. Energy stored in chemicals. Now build a circuit: one wire to the bulb. Nothing. Wire from plus, through the bulb, back to minus. The bulb lights! A circuit must go all the way round. A switch opens and closes the gap. Energy flows from the cell to the bulb and comes out as light.
visual_style: Whiteboard torch opening to reveal two cells, then a circuit loop that lights up when the last wire clips on.
mood: Curious problem-solving, like fixing something in the dark.
pacing: Power cut, open the torch, two failed circuits, one success, then the switch.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and look for the plus and minus signs on cells at home.
